reproducibility_header: Q4-PROMOTION-BUILD (BONDS x TIME-ARC) v1. Built 2026-11-23 entirely from banked build/ files: city_component_annual_v1.jsonl (2,509 rows; NYC dedup law: IBO-era per-agency 'total' rows -> one row per agency; Socrata 2020-2025 era -> city_funds rows as the like-to-like city-side continuation), murders_all_v1.json, population_series_v1.jsonl + populations_cities_v2.jsonl + populations_wide_v1.jsonl + phase2_pop_table.json (denominators; any city-year without a banked denominator ships as honest-null), bookings_facility_v1.jsonl (NYC DOC discharges wedge) + bookings_series_v1.jsonl (UCR-arrest booking proxy), peer_review scans v1-v11 carried as evidence anchors, _congregation_panel_v2.json (28 city-years) carried VERBATIM (format-lock). Pre-registered test (one-pager #8 Q4 / #7): component-arc = parks+libraries vs murder/bookings arcs at t+0/t+1/t+2, within-city demeaned+pooled-z (the congregation-test design carried to the merge). Direction-class only: thin city-year panels, no p-values, no causal claims per the no-fabrication law.

peer_review_scans_on_disk.note: all 11 scans present on disk (v7-v10 in {pairing, entries, summary} shape); corrects axis_availability_v1's v7-v10-absent note

merge_law.nyc_dedup: IBO era: subcomponent='total' rows only (one per agency); Socrata era: subcomponent='city_funds' rows only; raw-row summation would double-count (verified 1990/2000/2010/2015 parks+libraries) and is NOT used
merge_law.non_nyc: one component row per lane; zero/absent lane = honest-null (Cincinnati libraries = county levy => honest-null lane, never zero-filled)
merge_law.denominators: banked PEP/census files only; missing denominator = honest-null (no interpolated rates)
merge_law.bonds_core: parks + libraries (the decomposition's carriers per the 80x mix finding)
merge_law.lag_alignment: care_t -> murder-rate_t+lag; city's own series (within-city) so fiscal/calendar drift is bounded to within-city reads

verdict: BONDS-CORE CARRIES THE ARC (direction-class): parks+libraries within-city reads are negative at t0 (-0.594), t+1 (-0.539), t+2 (-0.510) at the triple-arc merge (40 full city-years, 5 cities, within-city pooled z), and the care-lane read replicates at t0/t+1/t+2 (-0.55/-0.57/-0.37). The congregation panel (28 city-years) is carried verbatim and extends: care_t -> rate t+1 -0.799 (n=24), t+2 -0.733 (n=20), 4-of-4 cities negative in both lanes. Bookings lane (UCR-arrest proxy, 23 city-years, 4 cities) reads -0.611 within-city. NYC DOC-discharges lane (+0.96) is the flagged mixed-grain exception (city-side care vs post-arraignment facility exits, opposite-sign mechanism class) — labeled, not excluded. Cincinnati's flat cross-decade read (+0.03) is the honest null-city of the merge (denominator-vintage limited). Thinnest lanes: libraries n=21 (3 cities), housing weakest negative (-0.299), consistent with the banked housing-flips-in-Detroit class. No p-values, no causal claims — the arc shape is the verdict.

Cincinnati.notes: denominator-limited: PEP/census banked years only; missing = honest-null

St. Louis.notes: denominator-limited: PEP/census banked years only; missing = honest-null

claim_boundary: within-city co-movement only; cross-city level effects removed by construction; reverse-causation (money-follows-crisis) not separated here — the t+0-vs-lag arc shape is the only timing read this design supports; NYC bookings join is mixed-grain (city-side care vs DOC discharges) and labeled so.
